眼睛.pinyin: Wǒ zhí shì tā de yǎn jing
眼睛.en: I looked him in the eyes.

眼睛.pinyin: Bì shang nǐ de yǎn jing

眼睛.zh: 你的眼睛为什么那么大？
眼睛.pinyin: Nǐ de yǎn jing wèi shén me nà me dà
眼睛.en: Why are your eyes so big?
眼睛.es: ¿Por qué tus ojos son tan grandes?

眼睛.zh: 我无法相信自己的眼睛。
眼睛.pinyin: Wǒ wú fǎ xiāng xìn zì jǐ de yǎn jing
眼睛.es: No puedo creer lo que ven mis ojos.

讲.zh: 他给我们讲了一个有趣的故事，我们都笑了起来。
讲.pinyin: Tā gěi wǒ men jiǎng le yī ge yǒu qù de gù shi wǒ men dōu xiào le qǐ lai
讲.en: He told us such a funny story that we all laughed.
讲.es: Nos contó una historia tan graciosa, que todos nos reímos.

讲.zh: 她给我讲了一个有趣的故事。
讲.pinyin: Tā gěi wǒ jiǎng le yī ge yǒu qù de gù shi
讲.en: She told me an interesting story.

讲.pinyin: Wǒ bù huì jiǎng rì běn huà

讲.zh: 我跟父母讲了留学的事情。
讲.pinyin: Wǒ gēn fù mǔ jiǎng le liú xué de shì qing
讲.en: I talked with my parents about my studying abroad.
讲.es: Hablé con mis padres acerca de estudiar en el extranjero.

其实.zh: 我不太喜欢他，其实我讨厌他。
其实.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài xǐ huan tā qí shí wǒ tǎo yàn tā
其实.en: I don't like him much, in fact I hate him.
其实.es: Él no me gusta mucho, de hecho, lo odio.

其实.pinyin: Nǐ qí shí yǒu méi yǒu kàn guo
其实.en: Did you read it at all?

其实.zh: 你以为自己醒着，但其实你可能是在做梦。
其实.pinyin: Nǐ yǐ wéi zì jǐ xǐng zhe dàn qí shí nǐ kě néng shì zài zuò mèng
其实.en: You think you're awake, but you may, in fact, be dreaming.
其实.es: Piensas que estás despierto pero puede ser que de hecho estés soñando.

其实.pinyin: Nǐ qí shí méi bì yào dài sǎn
其实.en: You needn't have taken an umbrella with you.
其实.es: No necesitabas llevar un paraguas contigo.

干净.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhuō zi shì gān jìng de
Méi yǒu rèn hé gān jìng de pán zi

干净.zh: 她总是把自己的房子打扫得很干净。
干净.pinyin: Tā zǒng shì bǎ zì jǐ de fáng zi dǎ sǎo de hěn gān jìng
干净.en: She always keeps her room clean.
干净.es: Ella siempre mantiene su cuarto limpio.

干净.zh: 他想把这些衬衫洗干净。
干净.pinyin: Tā xiǎng bǎ zhè xiē chèn shān xǐ gān jìng
干净.es: Él quiere que se laven estas camisas.

一边.zh: 他们一边唱歌一边走路。
一边.pinyin: Tā men yī biān chàng gē yī biān zǒu lù
一边.en: They went along the street singing the song.
一边.es: Ellos cantaban una canción mientras caminaban por la calle.

一边.zh: 她一边读这封信一边哭。
一边.pinyin: Tā yī biān dú zhè fēng xìn yī biān kū
一边.en: She cried as she read the letter.
一边.es: Ella lloró mientras leía la carta.

一边.zh: 他一边驾着车，一边快乐地吹着口哨。
一边.pinyin: Tā yī biān jià zhe chē yī biān kuài lè de chuī zhe kǒu shào
一边.en: He drove his car, whistling merrily.

一边.zh: 吉姆一边驾着车，一边愉快地吹着口哨。
一边.pinyin: Jí mǔ yī biān jià zhe chē yī biān yú kuài de chuī zhe kǒu shào
一边.en: Jim drove his car, whistling merrily.
一边.es: Jim conducía su coche, silbando alegremente.

护照.pinyin: Wǒ bì xū gēng xīn wǒ de hù zhào
Qǐng gěi wǒ kàn kan nín de hù zhào

护照.zh: 请把您的护照给我看一下。
护照.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ nín de hù zhào gěi wǒ kàn yī xià

护照.zh: 请让我看一下您的护照好吗？
护照.pinyin: Qǐng ràng wǒ kàn yī xià nín de hù zhào hǎo ma
护照.en: May I see your passport, please?

地铁.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chéng dì tiě qù
地铁.en: I want to get there by subway.
地铁.es: Quiero tomar el metro para ir.

地铁.pinyin: Wǒ zhēng zhá zhe jǐ chū dì tiě
地铁.en: I struggled to get out of the subway.

地铁.pinyin: Tā zài yín zuò dā chéng le dì tiě
地铁.en: She got on the subway at Ginza.

地铁.pinyin: Qǐng wèn dì tiě zài nǎr
地铁.en: Excuse me, where is the metro?
地铁.es: Puedo preguntar, donde queda el metro?

干.zh: 她帮她爸爸干了花园里的活。
干.pinyin: Tā bāng tā bà ba gān le huā yuán lǐ de huó
干.en: She helped her father with the work in the garden.
干.es: Ella ayudó a su padre con el trabajo en el jardín.

干.pinyin: Nǐ zhè me zǎo lái dào gān shèn má
干.en: What did you come here so early for?

干.pinyin: Shí zài xián de méi shì gān
干.en: I'm bored and I have nothing to do.
干.es: Estoy aburrido y no tengo nada que hacer.

准时.pinyin: Nǐ néng zhǔn shí zuò hǎo ma
准时.en: Can you make it on time?

准时.pinyin: Tā gāng hǎo zhǔn shí dào jiào
准时.en: He arrived at school exactly on time.

准时.zh: 我们的老师总是准时来上课。
准时.pinyin: Wǒ men de lǎo shī zǒng shì zhǔn shí lái shàng kè
准时.en: Our teacher is always on time for class.

准时.zh: 我禁不住想他会不会准时到。
准时.pinyin: Wǒ jīn bu zhù xiǎng tā huì bù huì zhǔn shí dào
准时.en: I cannot help wondering if he will come on time.

印象.zh: 我对你们的工作印象深刻。
印象.pinyin: Wǒ duì nǐ men de gōng zuò yìn xiàng shēn kè
印象.en: I'm very impressed by your work.
印象.es: Estoy muy impresionado con tu trabajo.

印象.zh: 我对他的第一印象果然没有错。
印象.pinyin: Wǒ duì tā de dì yī yìn xiàng guǒ rán méi yǒu cuò
印象.en: My first impression of him proved to be correct.
印象.es: Mi primera impresión acerca de él resultó ser correcta.

印象.pinyin: Nǐ duì zhōng guó yǒu shén me yìn xiàng
Nǐ duì měi guó yìn xiàng rú hé
印象.en: What's your impression of the United States?

社会.pinyin: Wǒ men de shè huì liáng yǒu bù qí
社会.en: In our society we find men of integrity along with crooks.
社会.es: En nuestra sociedad, encontramos a hombres íntegros entre los pillos.

社会.zh: 社会上满是不称职的医生。
社会.pinyin: Shè huì shàng mǎn shì bù chèn zhí de yī shēng
社会.en: The world is full of incompetent doctors.
社会.es: El mundo está lleno de médicos incompetentes.

社会.zh: 尊重法律是我们社会的基础。
社会.pinyin: Zūn zhòng fǎ lǜ shì wǒ men shè huì de jī chǔ
社会.en: Respect for law is fundamental to our society.

社会.zh: 我们上社会课的时候谈到了枪械管制的问题。
社会.pinyin: Wǒ men shàng shè huì kè de shí hou tán dào le qiāng xiè guǎn zhì de wèn tí
社会.en: We discussed gun control in social studies class.

盒子.zh: 我想要个能装这些玩具的盒子。
盒子.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng yào gè néng zhuāng zhè xiē wán jù de hé zi
盒子.en: I want a box in which to keep these toys.
盒子.es: Quiero una caja para guardar estos juguetes.

盒子.zh: 你可以拿大的盒子或是小的盒子。
盒子.pinyin: Nǐ kě yǐ ná dà de hé zi huò shì xiǎo de hé zi
盒子.en: You may take either the big box or the small one.
盒子.es: Puedes tomar la caja grande o la pequeña.

盒子.pinyin: Wǒ néng dǎ kāi hé zi ma

盒子.zh: 盒子里的一些苹果烂了。
盒子.pinyin: Hé zi lǐ de yī xiē píng guǒ làn le
盒子.en: Some of the apples in the box were rotten.
盒子.es: Algunas de las manzanas de la caja estaban podridas.

详细.pinyin: Wǒ xià zhōu huì xiáng xì shuō míng de
详细.en: I'll explain it in detail next week.
详细.es: La semana que viene lo explicaré en detalle.

详细.zh: 他详细地解释了他的计划。
详细.pinyin: Tā xiáng xì de jiě shì le tā de jì huà
详细.en: He explained his plans in detail.
详细.es: Él explicó sus planes en detalle.

详细.zh: 他详细地叙述了那场意外的经过。
详细.pinyin: Tā xiáng xì de xù shù le nà chǎng yì wài de jīng guò
详细.en: He gave a detailed description of the accident.
详细.es: Él dio una descripción detallada del accidente.

详细.zh: 详细叙述一下这起事故吧。
详细.pinyin: Xiáng xì xù shù yī xià zhè qǐ shì gù ba

敲.zh: 一个丑男人敲了我的门。
敲.pinyin: Yī ge chǒu nán rén qiāo le wǒ de mén
敲.en: An ugly man knocked on my door.
敲.es: Un hombre feo llamó a mi puerta.

敲.pinyin: Děng děng yǒu rén zài qiāo wǒ de mén
敲.en: Hold on, someone is knocking at my door.

敲.pinyin: Tā qiāo le qiāo jǐn bì de mén
敲.en: He knocked on the closed door.

估计.zh: 根据我的估计，她现在应该在印度了。
估计.pinyin: Gēn jù wǒ de gū jì tā xiàn zài yīng gāi zài yìn dù le
估计.en: According to my calculation, she should be in India by now.
估计.es: De acuerdo a mis cálculos, ella debería estar en India por ahora.

估计.zh: 我们估计能在两周内到那个地方。
估计.pinyin: Wǒ men gū jì néng zài liǎng zhōu nèi dào nà ge dì fang
估计.en: We calculated that we could reach the place within two weeks.
估计.es: Previmos que llegaríamos a ese lugar en el plazo de dos semanas.

估计.zh: 我上次计算，估计我已经学会了两千五百个汉字左右。
估计.pinyin: Wǒ shàng cì jì suàn gū jì wǒ yǐ jīng xué huì le liǎng qiān wǔ bǎi gè hàn zì zuǒ yòu
估计.en: Last time I counted, I estimated that I know around 2500 Chinese characters.
估计.es: La última vez que conté, calculé que me sabía alrededor de 2500 caracteres chinos.

估计.pinyin: Sǔn shī shì wú fǎ gū jì de

收拾.zh: 我想在我父母来之前收拾干净屋子。
收拾.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài wǒ fù mǔ lái zhī qián shōu shi gān jìng wū zi
收拾.en: I want to clean the house before my parents come.
收拾.es: Quiero limpiar la casa antes de que vengan mis padres.

收拾.pinyin: Nǐ shōu shi hǎo dōng xi le méi yǒu

收拾.zh: 我妈要求我把我的房间收拾好。
收拾.pinyin: Wǒ mā yāo qiú wǒ bǎ wǒ de fáng jiān shōu shi hǎo
收拾.en: My mother told me to clean the room.

和平.zh: 我梦见的是一个没有战争的、和平的世界。
和平.pinyin: Wǒ mèng jiàn de shì yī ge méi yǒu zhàn zhēng de hé píng de shì jiè
和平.en: The world which I saw in my dream was a peaceful world devoid of war.
和平.es: El mundo que vi en mi sueño era un mundo pacífico carente de guerra.

和平.pinyin: Wǒ men kě wàng hé píng
Tā men guo zhe hé píng de shēng huó

和平.zh: 国际间的纷争一定要用和平的方法来解决。
和平.pinyin: Guó jì jiān de fēn zhēng yī dìng yào yòng hé píng de fāng fǎ lái jiě jué
和平.en: International disputes must be settled peacefully.
和平.es: Las disputas internacionales deben resolverse de forma pacífica.

成就.zh: 他的论文总结了电脑，人造卫星和火箭三个的新成就。
成就.pinyin: Tā de lùn wén zǒng jié le diàn nǎo rén zào wèi xīng hé huǒ jiàn sān gè de xīn chéng jiù
成就.en: His thesis summed up the new achievements made in computers, artificial satellites and rockets.
成就.es: Su tesis sintetiza los nuevos logros conseguidos en cuanto a ordenadores, satélites artificiales y cohetes espaciales.

成就.zh: 她很有可能会有所成就。
成就.pinyin: Tā hěn yǒu kě néng huì yǒu suǒ chéng jiù
成就.es: Es probable que ella tenga éxito.

成就.zh: 他们在不同的领域取得了卓越的成就。
成就.pinyin: Tā men zài bù tóng de lǐng yù qǔ dé le zhuó yuè de chéng jiù
成就.en: They have achieved excellent results in different fields.

成就.zh: 对他自己的成就他从不感到满意。
成就.pinyin: Duì tā zì jǐ de chéng jiù tā cóng bù gǎn dào mǎn yì
成就.en: He was never content with his success.

显示.zh: 我的刻录软件显示了一个错误信息。
显示.pinyin: Wǒ de kè lù ruǎn jiàn xiǎn shì le yī ge cuò wù xìn xī
显示.en: My data-burning software is showing an error message.
显示.es: Mi software grabador está mostrando un mensaje de error.

显示.zh: 错误是如何显示出来的？
显示.pinyin: Cuò wù shì rú hé xiǎn shì chū lái de

显示.zh: 他们的调查结果显示这篇报导是真实的。
显示.pinyin: Tā men de diào chá jié guǒ xiǎn shì zhè piān bào dǎo shì zhēn shí de
显示.en: The report proved true as a result of their investigation.

显示.zh: 最近的一项调查显示吸烟的人数减少了。
显示.pinyin: Zuì jìn de yī xiàng diào chá xiǎn shì xī yān de rén shù jiǎn shǎo le
显示.en: A recent survey shows that the number of smokers is decreasing.

现象.zh: 酸雨不是自然的天气现象。
现象.pinyin: Suān yǔ bù shì zì rán de tiān qì xiàn xiàng
现象.en: Acid rain is not a natural phenomenon.
现象.es: La lluvia ácida no es un fenómeno meteorológico natural.

现象.zh: 彩虹是自然界最美的现象之一。
现象.pinyin: Cǎi hóng shì zì rán jiè zuì měi dí xiàn xiàng zhī yī
现象.en: A rainbow is one of the most beautiful phenomena of nature.
现象.es: El arcoíris es uno de los fenómenos naturales más hermosos.

现象.zh: 月食是一种罕见的现象。
现象.pinyin: Yuè shí shì yī zhǒng hǎn jiàn de xiàn xiàng
现象.en: An eclipse of the moon is a rare phenomenon.

现象.zh: 现在很多年轻人追捧小鲜肉的现象正常吗？
现象.pinyin: Xiàn zài hěn duō nián qīng rén zhuī pěng xiǎo xiān ròu de xiàn xiàng zhèng cháng ma
现象.en: Is it normal that many young people these days idolize pretty boy stars?

宠物.pinyin: Wǒ de chǒng wù shēng bìng le

宠物.zh: 美国政府一直视英国为美国的宠物。
宠物.pinyin: Měi guó zhèng fǔ yī zhí shì yīng guó wèi měi guó de chǒng wù
宠物.en: The American government has always regarded England as America's house pet.
宠物.es: El gobierno de Estados Unidos siempre ha considerado a Inglaterra como su mascota.

宠物.zh: 合理地喂狗可以延长宠物寿命。
宠物.pinyin: Hé lǐ de wèi gǒu kě yǐ yán cháng chǒng wù shòu mìng
宠物.en: If you feed your dog properly, you can increase his lifespan.
宠物.es: Si alimentas adecuadamente a tu perro, puedes aumentar su periodo de vida.

冲.zh: 她在大街上看见我的时候冲我笑了笑。
冲.pinyin: Tā zài dà jiē shàng kàn jiàn wǒ de shí hou chōng wǒ xiào le xiào
冲.en: She smiled at me as she passed me in the street.
冲.es: Ella me sonrió al pasarme en la calle.

冲.en: Don't forget to flush the toilet.

冲.pinyin: Cè suǒ chōng shuǐ bù zhèng cháng

冲.zh: 杰西正在烧开水来冲咖啡。
冲.pinyin: Jié xī zhèng zài shāo kāi shuǐ lái chōng kā fēi
冲.en: Jessie is boiling water to make coffee.
冲.es: Jessie está hirviendo agua para hacer café.

评价.pinyin: Wǒ duì tā de píng jià hěn hǎo
评价.en: I had a good opinion of her.

评价.zh: 老板对你的工作有很高的评价。
评价.pinyin: Lǎo bǎn duì nǐ de gōng zuò yǒu hěn gāo de píng jià
评价.en: The boss has a good opinion of your work.
评价.es: El jefe tiene muy buena opinión de tu trabajo.

评价.zh: 这个事件过后我对他的评价很高。
评价.pinyin: Zhè ge shì jiàn guò hòu wǒ duì tā de píng jià hěn gāo
评价.en: After the incident I came to have a higher opinion of him.

评价.zh: 我知道你对他评价很高。
评价.pinyin: Wǒ zhī dào nǐ duì tā píng jià hěn gāo
评价.en: I know you think highly of him.

表情.zh: 他说话时，显然带着高兴的表情。
表情.pinyin: Tā shuō huà shí xiǎn rán dài zhe gāo xìng de biǎo qíng

表情.zh: 我从你的表情猜到你有好消息。
表情.pinyin: Wǒ cóng nǐ de biǎo qíng cāi dào nǐ yǒu hǎo xiāo xi
表情.en: I perceive by your face that you have good news.

表情.zh: 从他们的表情可以知道，他们大概是失败了。
表情.pinyin: Cóng tā men de biǎo qíng kě yǐ zhī dào tā men dà gài shì shī bài le
表情.en: From the way they look, I would say that they failed.

表情.pinyin: Nǐ nà shi shén me biǎo qíng

甲.zh: 手甲的生长速度比脚甲快四倍。
甲.pinyin: Shǒu jiǎ de shēng zhǎng sù dù bǐ jiǎo jiǎ kuài sì bèi
甲.en: Fingernails grow nearly four times faster than toenails.
甲.es: Las uñas de la mano crecen casi cuatro veces más rápido que las de los pies.

甲.pinyin: Jiǎ zhī mì táng yǐ zhī pī shuāng
甲.en: One man's meat is another man's poison.
甲.es: La basura de un hombre es el tesoro de otro.

甲.zh: 这块龟腹甲的甲桥上有三个字的刻辞。
甲.pinyin: Zhè kuài guī fù jiǎ de jiǎ qiáo shàng yǒu sān gè zì de kè cí
甲.en: There are three words engraved on the bridge of the plastron of this turtle.

甲.pinyin: Guì lín shān shuǐ jiǎ tiān xià
甲.en: Guilin's sceneries are the most beautiful ones under the heaven.

合法.pinyin: Nǐ de xíng wéi wán quán hé fǎ
Shuì shōu jiù shì hé fǎ de qiǎng jié

蹲.zh: 汤姆蹲了三年多的监狱。
蹲.pinyin: Tāng mǔ dūn le sān nián duō de jiān yù
蹲.en: Tom spent more than three years in jail.

蹲.zh: 抢劫银行的后果就是在监狱里蹲十年。
蹲.pinyin: Qiǎng jié yín háng de hòu guǒ jiù shì zài jiān yù lǐ dūn shí nián
蹲.en: Bank robbery will cost you ten years in prison.
